_readme: Neocloud 信用层债券登记表 —— neocloud_credit_monitor.py 的输入。
两块内容：terms(静态条款，很少变) + quote(报价，每次 WebSearch 取到新价就更新 price 与 as_of)。
tier 决定该债进哪一层判定：'corp' = 发行人公司层无担保债(L1)；'spv_ig_tenant' = 项目层/投资级租户 SPV(L2)；'convert' = 转债(仅参考，不参与判定)。
报价没有免费 API。流程：日报的 WebSearch 步骤拿到价格 → 填进 quote.price + quote.as_of + quote.source → 脚本自己算 YTM 与利差。
quote.as_of 超过 --max-quote-age(默认5天) 的债券判为 ⚪ 数据过期，不参与触发判定（不臆测、不沿用旧价当新价）。
maturity_precision='month' 表示只知到月份、日期取当月15日，YTM 误差约 ±3bp，可接受；拿到精确日期就改成 'day'。
新增债券时必须填 currency；EUR 债不与美债曲线比，只对 EUR HY 指数做相对比较。

quote.quote_kind 区分同一天的两种价：'close_clean'(当日结算/干净价，缺省) 与 'intraday_indicative'(盘中指示性报价)。as_of 只有日期、分辨不出两者——2026-09-10 曾同日两跑，盘中 88.71(利差777bp) 被盘后 86.75(827bp) 覆写，50bp 正好是个体/宏观判别的一整个单位。盘中报价**计入当日读数，但永不作 30 日变化率基准**；盘中那次运行不要落历史档(--no-history)。

_readme: 一级市场是 L1 里信息含量最高的一项：发行人被迫让价 = 实时重定价，比二级指数 OAS 敏感得多。
每次 WebSearch 到 neocloud 新发债/杠杆贷款条款就追加一条；status: 'priced'|'repricing'|'pulled'|'postponed'。
spread_bp 用基准利率(SOFR/UST)之上的点数；oid 是发行折价(面值100)。脚本按 SOFR 折算全包成本。

deals.source: 发行人一级来源：IREN Ltd FY26 业绩发布正文，SEC EDGAR sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1878848/000187884826000051/irenreportsfy26results.htm。逐字要点：$2.8B new GPU financings for non-investment grade customer deployments；$2.4B led by Blue Owl 与 Pacific Investment Management Company LLC (as adviser)；Mackenzie 风冷扩建融资逐字「9.0% fixed rate」。⚠️ 三点必须随本笔一起读：(1) 来源措辞为 committed，未写 closed/priced，本条 status 填 "priced" 是枚举内最接近项，非来源原词；(2) 未披露初始与最终利差指引，initial_spread_bp / final_spread_bp 皆留 null、未回填、不估算，故该笔不进 L1 候选过滤器；(3) date 2026-08-27 取 IREN FY26 业绩发布日（该融资随业绩公布），非必然为逐笔定价日。本笔与资产档现存 2026-06 IREN $3.65B 投资级 GPU 融资（$2.10B 私募 ≈SOFR+213bp、$1.55B DDTL SOFR+225bp）为不同交易。

deals.source: Bloomberg 2026-09-23 https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-09-23/coreweave-tied-data-center-raises-1-1-billion-in-junk-bonds (HTTP 403; terms from search snippets); launch 2026-09-21 https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-09-21/coreweave-tied-data-center-project-kicks-off-junk-bond-offering ; secondary: https://www.briefs.co/news/blue-owl-backed-data-center-borrower-lands-1-1-billion-with/ . deals.instrument: Senior secured fixed-rate delayed draw term loan due 2033-05-30 (marketed to insurance companies and fixed income investors)
deals.purpose: Fund purchase and development of GPU infrastructure supporting three committed customer deployments with two investment-grade offtakers across multiple data centers
deals.source: Issuer release https://lambda.ai/blog/lambda-closes-1-billion-senior-secured-fixed-rate-financing (dated 2026-10-01; Business Wire 20261001276698, Morningstar mirror HTTP 403). Terms: $1.008 billion delayed draw term loan, 6.78% fixed rate semi-annual coupon, final maturity 2033-05-30, Morningstar DBRS A (low) / Moody's Baa1, J.P. Morgan sole coordinating lead arranger, structuring agent and bookrunner. Release wording: 'closes'; status 'priced' is the nearest enum value, not the source word; date 2026-10-01 is the release date, not necessarily the pricing date. Release says pricing was 'inside the target pricing range' but does not disclose the range numerically. Fixed-rate: no SOFR spread disclosed, spread/OID fields null (not estimated). Note: ccir.io tracker shows a derived +161bp over a 6.66y Treasury; that is a third-party computation, not issuer-disclosed, and is not filled into any spread field.

Date uncertainty: 2026-09-28 (tracker) vs 2026-10-01 (release); date takes release date. Status 'priced' is nearest enum value, source says 'entered into'. Fees/OID not disclosed; fixed rate so spread fields null (not estimated). Issuer is a smaller APAC neocloud, not in the named issuer list.
